N21 (13 Nov 2026): AEMO's half-hourly demand is net of rooftop PV and small solar; their recorded output is added back at its own shape before the calibration, so Arena's subtraction no longer takes midday demand out twice.

Forward period (13 Nov 2026): demand after the forecast start grows the calibrated base-year profile (total generation), not AEMO's operational demand, which lacks exports, non-scheduled and rooftop output (2021 demand was 10 % low).

Three causes, each repaired: (1) the installation register (APVI) stops in September 2019; the CER postcode record replaces it for 2011-2019 (scripts/data/cer_solar_vic_csv.py; 2011-2018 agree within 0.5 %, 2019 adds 191 MW); (2) missing solar_ghi half-hours gave no output; they are filled from the same half-hour on nearby days (always on);

Forward rooftop fleet: the ISP energy path (x 1.25, LoadData) divided by the model's own yield per kW, from the recorded 2019 fleet and replacing 30-year-old systems; before, energy increments were converted at a 20 % capacity factor from 2021 (the model's yield is about 14 %), and nothing was added in 2020
